name: pudding-visual-essay-factory
description: Reusable production factory for The Pudding-style interactive scrollytelling visual essays.

scripts.pipeline:smoke: cd pipeline && uv run python -m src.emit_smoke
scripts.pipeline:check: cd pipeline && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ty check
scripts.web:typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix audit run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run pipeline:check && npm run pipeline:smoke && npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:build && npm run audit:tier-a -- --smoke
